figures.title: Global Workforce by Age and Gender

figures.description: One entry per figure printed on the page, in page order

title.description: Figure title as printed, excluding the figure label

yAxisLabels.description: Y-axis tick labels as printed, bottom to top

xAxisLabels.description: X-axis category labels as printed, left to right

legend.description: Legend entries as printed, in legend order

legendNote.description: Any key printed beneath the legend, null if absent

employmentLevelBreakdown.description: Figure 20: headcount for each employment level in each year

ageAndGenderBreakdown.description: Figure 21: headcount by age band for each year and gender, one entry per bar

ageBand.description: Age band label as printed in the legend

workforceByGender.description: Data on the workforce split by gender, listed by year. Round all numbers to the nearest thousand.

male.description: Number of male employees in that year rounded to nearest thousand (i.e. 1,234 should be 1000).

female.description: Number of female employees in that year rounded to nearest thousand (i.e. 8,904 should be 9000).

topWorkforceSector.description: The largest employment category (e.g. Sales, Operations, Finance, etc.)
